title: PvP Overhauled
description: All you need for pvp! Shorter Swords, transparent hud and much more!
body:
Improve your PvP experience with this pack! Shorter swords, transparent hud and much more!
This pack adds:
- Shorter Diamond-,netherite- and ironswords
- A better Hotbar
- A Smaller and animated Totems for better sight
- Visible Trapped chest
- A transparent Inventory
- Low shield
- A high resolution font and darkmode design
- Better looking diamond and netherite armor
- Better Sprites like Hearts or armorbars
- Impoved textures for wind charges and enderpearls
  More will be added soon...


Some textures like the Totem or the hearts are from Swights Texturepack so check it out ;)
